derivation: from G1 (Α) (as a negative particle) and a derivative of G3334 (μετακινέω);

occurrences.text: Therefore, my beloved brethren, be ye stedfast, unmoveable, always abounding in the work of the Lord, forasmuch as ye know that your labour is not in vain in the Lord.
